title: Zero-interaction full automation across CLI, daemon, MCP, harness, agents, and cloud
goal: Eliminate interactive stalls across Core (unattended sealed vault / /run/secrets discovery, KDBX single-pass CSV sync + corrupt header avoidance, CLI idle-pipe skip on explicit prompt, non-interactive git/ssh/gh/cloud/agent env propagation, bounded stdio/docker/kubectl subprocesses, daemon systemd/launchd env & unattended maintenance sync).

reuse.reason: Reuses susi-paths::console and susi-config::SealedVault/keepass_bridge/cloud_env rather than duplicating timeout/pipe/env helpers across workspace crates.
reuse.searched: Checked susi-paths::console, susi-config, susi-gemi, susi-harness, susi-tools, susi-gmcp, susi-gawd, susi-gawd-agents, susi-daemon, susi-daemon-runtime, src/cli, deploy/compose, scripts.
